claims.text: Two separate research passes for a Kano rent-control or tenancy statute returned no Nigerian authority at all.
A Kano tenant has no statutory figure to point to and no tribunal to apply to about the rent itself — so everything turns on the tenancy agreement.
Your tenancy agreement is your only shield.
In Kano, everything depends on that paper.
Make sure it covers rent, notice, and repairs.
Make sure it spells out your rent, notice periods, and who fixes what.

post.headline: Moving to Kano? Your tenancy agreement is your only shield.
